# [TASK] Tests and docs: complex natural-language search

## Task
Round out test coverage for the complex-query feature end to end and update
docs.

## Parent Story
Parent: #198

## Scope
Coverage gaps left after Tasks #202-#205's own inline tests — not a full
re-test of everything already covered there.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] ai-service: edge cases not yet covered (empty query, nonsense query, query exceeding `PromptSanitizer`'s length cap)
- [x] Frontend: an integration-level test exercising typed search end to end (component -> dispatched action -> API call shape)
- [x] `backend/ai-service/README.md`'s API table updated with the new endpoint
- [x] JaCoCo/Istanbul coverage for touched code meets the project threshold

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
Added empty-query 400 tests for `/search/query` and `/search/execute`, a nonsense-query test proving the fallback reaches movie-service with the exact raw text, and a test proving the "neither person nor plain title" shape short-circuits before any downstream call. The length-cap criterion was already covered by a pre-existing test.

Added `Search.integration.test.jsx` — the first test wiring `Search` to the real `aiApi` reducer and middleware rather than a mocked hook.

README's API table gained `/search/query` and `/search/execute`.
